CREATE UNIQUE INDEX currents_one_dataset ON currents_definitions(kind) WHERE kind='Dataset'
CREATE INDEX holds_open_credit ON holds (credit_handle, position) WHERE resolved_by IS NULL
CREATE INDEX holds_open_debit  ON holds (debit_handle, position)  WHERE resolved_by IS NULL
CREATE INDEX holds_open_due    ON holds (expires, position)       WHERE resolved_by IS NULL AND expires IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX leaves_by_kind ON leaves (kind, position)
CREATE INDEX policy_versions_in_force ON policy_versions (effective, position)
CREATE INDEX posting_dims_by_value ON posting_dims (axis, value, position, idx)
CREATE INDEX postings_by_day     ON postings (booking, position, idx)
CREATE INDEX postings_by_key     ON postings (handle, currency, layer, position, idx)
CREATE INDEX postings_by_key_day ON postings (handle, currency, layer, booking, position, idx)

CREATE TABLE account_versions (
    handle     INTEGER  NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (handle),
    field      INTEGER  NOT NULL CHECK (field IN (0, 1, 2)),
    effective  INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    position   INTEGER  NOT NULL REFERENCES leaves (position),
    open_from  INTEGER,
    open_to    INTEGER,
    limit_code INTEGER  CHECK (limit_code IN (0, 1, 2)),
    class      TEXT,
    CHECK (field <> 0 OR open_from IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (field <> 1 OR limit_code IS NOT NULL),
    PRIMARY KEY (handle, field, position)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE accounts (
    handle   INTEGER  PRIMARY KEY CHECK (handle BETWEEN 0 AND 4294967295),
    path     TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    kind     INTEGER  NOT NULL CHECK (kind BETWEEN 0 AND 4),
    position INTEGER  NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES leaves (position)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE balances (
    handle   INTEGER   NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (handle),
    currency TEXT  NOT NULL,
    layer    INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (layer IN (0, 1)),
    debit    BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(debit) = 16),
    credit   BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(credit) = 16),
    postings INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (postings >= 1),
    PRIMARY KEY (handle, currency, layer)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE cleared (
    position INTEGER   NOT NULL,
    idx      INTEGER   NOT NULL,
    applied  BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(applied) = 16),
    PRIMARY KEY (position, idx),
    FOREIGN KEY (position, idx) REFERENCES postings (position, idx)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE clearing_refs (
    position INTEGER  NOT NULL REFERENCES clearings (position),
    handle   INTEGER  NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (handle),
    currency TEXT NOT NULL,
    layer    INTEGER  NOT NULL CHECK (layer IN (0, 1)),
    PRIMARY KEY (position, handle, currency, layer)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE clearing_resets (
    clearing INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES clearings (position),
    position INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES clearings (position)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE clearings (
    position INTEGER   PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES leaves (position),
    idem_key BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(idem_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 128)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE currency_versions (
    code      TEXT NOT NULL,
    exponent  INTEGER  NOT NULL CHECK (exponent BETWEEN 0 AND 18),
    effective INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    position  INTEGER  NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES leaves (position),
    PRIMARY KEY (code, position)
) STRICT
CREATE TABLE currents_atomic_records (command_id BLOB PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(command_id)=16), record BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(record)>0 AND length(record)<=1048576)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE currents_blobs (
 digest BLOB PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(digest)=32), byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_count>=0 AND byte_count<=104857600),
 first_seq INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES currents_commits(seq)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE currents_chunks (
 digest BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES currents_blobs(digest), position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position>=0),
 bytes BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(bytes)<=1048576), chunk_digest BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(chunk_digest)=32), PRIMARY KEY(digest,position)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE currents_commits (
 seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(seq>0), previous_digest BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(previous_digest)=32),
 digest BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(digest)=32), canonical BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(canonical)<=67108864),
 checkpoint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(checkpoint)<=1024), command_id BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(command_id)=16)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE currents_content_refs (
 seq INTEGER NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL, digest BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES currents_blobs(digest),
 FOREIGN KEY(seq,position) REFERENCES currents_items(seq,position)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE currents_definitions (
 kind TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>=0), seq INTEGER NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(kind,id,version), FOREIGN KEY(seq,position) REFERENCES currents_items(seq,position)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE currents_items (
 seq INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES currents_commits(seq), position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position>=0),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL, digest BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(digest)=32), canonical BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(canonical)<=1048576),
 PRIMARY KEY(seq,position)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE currents_references (
 seq INTEGER NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL, target_kind TEXT NOT NULL, target_id TEXT NOT NULL, target_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 FOREIGN KEY(seq,position) REFERENCES currents_items(seq,position),
 FOREIGN KEY(target_kind,target_id,target_version) REFERENCES currents_definitions(kind,id,version)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE currents_staging_chunks (
 token BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES currents_staging(token), position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position>=0), bytes BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(bytes)<=1048576),
 chunk_digest BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(chunk_digest)=32), PRIMARY KEY(token,position)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE entries (
    position    INTEGER   PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES leaves (position),
    ordinal     INTEGER   NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (ordinal >= 0),
    entry_id    BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(entry_id) = 16),
    idem_key    BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(idem_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    fingerprint BLOB CHECK (fingerprint IS NULL OR length(fingerprint) = 32),
    reverses    BLOB UNIQUE REFERENCES entries (entry_id),
    kind        TEXT  CHECK (kind IS NULL OR length(kind) BETWEEN 1 AND 256)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE holds (
    position      INTEGER   PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES entries (position),
    entry_id      BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES entries (entry_id),
    booking       INTEGER   NOT NULL,
    expires       INTEGER,
    debit_handle  INTEGER   NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (handle),
    credit_handle INTEGER   NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (handle),
    currency      TEXT  NOT NULL,
    amount        BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(amount) = 16),
    resolved_by   BLOB UNIQUE REFERENCES entries (entry_id),
    how           INTEGER   CHECK (how IN (0, 1, 2)),
    CHECK ((resolved_by IS NULL) = (how IS NULL))
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE leaves (
    position INTEGER   PRIMARY KEY CHECK (position >= 0),
    kind     INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (kind BETWEEN 1 AND 8),
    bytes    BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(bytes) BETWEEN 1 AND 65535)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE memos (
    position INTEGER   PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES entries (position),
    salt     BLOB CHECK (salt IS NULL OR length(salt) = 16),
    text     TEXT,
    CHECK ((salt IS NULL) = (text IS NULL))
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE meta (
    singleton    INTEGER   PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
    schema_id    TEXT  NOT NULL,
    ledger_id    TEXT  NOT NULL,
    amount_scale INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (amount_scale BETWEEN 0 AND 18),
    genesis      BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(genesis) = 32)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE nodes (
    id   INTEGER   PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id >= 0),
    hash BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(hash) = 32)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE outstanding (
    handle   INTEGER   NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (handle),
    currency TEXT  NOT NULL,
    debit    BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(debit) = 16),
    credit   BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(credit) = 16),
    PRIMARY KEY (handle, currency)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE periods (
    period_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    first_day INTEGER  NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    last_day  INTEGER  NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (last_day >= first_day),
    position  INTEGER  NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES leaves (position)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE policy_versions (
    position  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES leaves (position),
    effective INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE posting_dims (
    position INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    idx      INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    axis     TEXT NOT NULL,
    value    TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (position, idx, axis),
    FOREIGN KEY (position, idx) REFERENCES postings (position, idx)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE postings (
    position     INTEGER   NOT NULL REFERENCES entries (position),
    idx          INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (idx BETWEEN 0 AND 1023),
    handle       INTEGER   NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (handle),
    currency     TEXT  NOT NULL,
    layer        INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (layer IN (0, 1)),
    side         INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (side IN (0, 1)),
    amount       BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(amount) = 16),
    booking      INTEGER   NOT NULL,
    value_date   INTEGER   NOT NULL,
    dimensions   TEXT  NOT NULL,
    debit_after  BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(debit_after) = 16),
    credit_after BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(credit_after) = 16),
    count_after  INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (count_after >= 1),
    PRIMARY KEY (position, idx)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE seal_leaves (
    period_id TEXT  NOT NULL REFERENCES seals (period_id),
    currency  TEXT  NOT NULL,
    layer     INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (layer IN (0, 1)),
    handle    INTEGER   NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (handle),
    debit     BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(debit) = 16),
    credit    BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(credit) = 16),
    postings  INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (postings >= 1),
    PRIMARY KEY (period_id, currency, layer, handle)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE seal_nodes (
    period_id TEXT  NOT NULL REFERENCES seals (period_id),
    currency  TEXT  NOT NULL,
    layer     INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (layer IN (0, 1)),
    level     INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (level BETWEEN 0 AND 32),
    idx       INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (idx >= 0),
    hash      BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(hash) = 32),
    PRIMARY KEY (period_id, currency, layer, level, idx)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE seals (
    period_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES periods (period_id),
    position  INTEGER  NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES leaves (position)
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE slices (
    handle     INTEGER   NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (handle),
    currency   TEXT  NOT NULL,
    dimensions TEXT  NOT NULL,
    debit      BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(debit) = 16),
    credit     BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(credit) = 16),
    postings   INTEGER   NOT NULL CHECK (postings >= 1),
    PRIMARY KEY (handle, currency, dimensions)
) STRICT
CREATE TRIGGER account_versions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON account_versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'doubleentry: DELETE on account_versions refused (append-only)'); END

CREATE TRIGGER account_versions_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON account_versions
  WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_versions o WHERE (o.handle = NEW.handle AND o.field = NEW.field AND o.position = NEW.position))
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'doubleentry: REPLACE on account_versions refused (a row with its key exists)'); END

CREATE TRIGGER entries_fingerprint_erase_only BEFORE UPDATE ON entries
  WHEN OLD.fingerprint IS NULL OR NEW.fingerprint IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.position IS NOT OLD.position OR NEW.ordinal IS NOT OLD.ordinal
    OR NEW.entry_id IS NOT OLD.entry_id OR NEW.idem_key IS NOT OLD.idem_key
    OR NEW.reverses IS NOT OLD.reverses
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memos m WHERE m.position = OLD.position AND m.text IS NULL)
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'doubleentry: UPDATE on entries refused (fingerprint erase only)'); END

CREATE TRIGGER entries_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON entries
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'doubleentry: DELETE on entries refused (append-only)'); END

CREATE TRIGGER entries_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON entries
  WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entries o WHERE (o.position = NEW.position) OR (o.ordinal = NEW.ordinal) OR (o.entry_id = NEW.entry_id) OR (o.idem_key = NEW.idem_key) OR (o.reverses = NEW.reverses))
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'doubleentry: REPLACE on entries refused (a row with its key exists)'); END

CREATE TRIGGER holds_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON holds
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'doubleentry: DELETE on holds refused (resolve once)'); END

CREATE TRIGGER holds_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON holds
  WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM holds o WHERE (o.position = NEW.position) OR (o.entry_id = NEW.entry_id) OR (o.resolved_by = NEW.resolved_by))
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'doubleentry: REPLACE on holds refused (a row with its key exists)'); END

CREATE TRIGGER holds_resolve_once BEFORE UPDATE ON holds
  WHEN OLD.resolved_by IS NOT NULL OR NEW.resolved_by IS NULL
    OR NEW.position IS NOT OLD.position OR NEW.entry_id IS NOT OLD.entry_id
    OR NEW.booking IS NOT OLD.booking OR NEW.expires IS NOT OLD.expires
    OR NEW.debit_handle IS NOT OLD.debit_handle OR NEW.credit_handle IS NOT OLD.credit_handle
    OR NEW.currency IS NOT OLD.currency OR NEW.amount IS NOT OLD.amount
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'doubleentry: UPDATE on holds refused (resolve once)'); END

CREATE TRIGGER memos_erase_only BEFORE UPDATE ON memos
